Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE original outfit concept sheet for the ORVASK pixel-art game. Image 1 is the approved protagonist: preserve adult slim human proportions, the short brim earflap work hat with small rectangular lamp, warm simple face, rust-red scarf and brown work boots. This is a new clothing design for the SAME person. Image 2 is environment palette / broad shape language only; do not reproduce scenery.
Layout: landscape sheet with TWO equally large full-body figures side by side on flat muted medium slate-gray background: left front three-quarter facing right, right rear three-quarter showing pack. Identical neutral relaxed standing pose, hands lowered away from belt, empty hands, no weapons; feet same baseline, generous margins, both figures same height. No text, labels, cards, decorative border or UI.
CRITICAL STYLE: Match the very chunky, quiet pixel clusters of input 1. Each figure should feel like a carefully designed approximately 50-pixel-wide by 100-pixel-tall sprite enlarged with nearest-neighbor, not a finely rendered illustration with a pixel filter. Broad flat cloth masses, 2-3 grouped shadow values per material, selectively soft low-contrast edges but crisp square stair steps. No optical blur. No micro scratches, scattered single pixels, tiny rivets, dense folds, glossy highlights, dithering, painterly rendering, thick black outline or bloom. World-worn retro-future workwear with salvage technology, functionality and lived-in warmth. Muted slate, dirty neutral fabric, restrained warm accents. Do not copy a particular ARC Raiders skin; use the principle of ordinary functional clothing combined with worn industrial technology. Make the outfit's dominant silhouette readable at small game scale (roughly 90 px character height). Preserve room for future gun and arm poses; gear never hides head or hands.
OUTFIT SPECIFICATION: Short muted ochre heat-resistant shoulder cape over slate work trousers and a thigh-length work jacket; high padded collar below the red scarf, broad rounded protected shoulders. Two long low-profile canister-shaped storage pouches at hips. A SMALL flat back heat-exchanger box with just three broad horizontal slats. Mostly fabric, visibly soft practical protective material, simple worn insulated gloves. Preserve slender legs. Distinguishing shapes: rounded ochre upper silhouette, compact rectangular rear pack, two hip cylinders. No giant tanks or flame effects.
